execution_stages.purpose: Catch worker-packet, wait/wake, evaluator, state-persistence, and fixture-contract defects before expensive replication.
execution_stages.freeze_rule: Any fixture/prompt/harness/protocol change after screening invalidates screening comparability and requires a fresh screening pass.

screening_findings.finding: Terminal submission shape was under-specified: observed_results had named field only, while the frozen evaluator requires experiment_id -> raw result_hash string.
screening_findings.consequence: Prior completed P0 runs remain valid non-claim-bearing evidence that the protocol caught and recovered from the defect, but they do not constitute a frozen comparable screening pass after the protocol clarification.
screening_findings.required_action: Re-screen affected matched P0 Instant persistent-chat arms under the clarified public terminal_output_schema before expanding or scoring.

clarified_p0_re_screen.result: Both runs passed research_iterate_objective_v1 with score 1.0, zero violations, 3 reasoning invocations, 2 experiment requests, 0 retries, 0 frontier escalations, 0 model polling, 0 manual state relays, and 0 authority/provenance violations.

p0_primary_a_e.interpretation: P0 primary arm mechanics are operational under the clarified protocol. This remains non-claim-bearing protocol-screening evidence only; P1-P3 primary screening remains required.

execution_stages.next_action: Execute the already-instantiated non-claim-bearing P1 primary A-E screening slots next. If P1 completes without protocol changes, proceed to P2 and P3. Any fixture/prompt/harness/protocol change requires fresh affected screening.

execution_stages.purpose: Estimate validated quality, reliability, routing behavior, and resource use under a frozen protocol.
execution_stages.prerequisite: protocol_screening completes with no hard-gate failure and no protocol changes pending.

allowed_inputs: exact evidence refs named by run state
worker_isolation.worker_repository_read_rule: Workers may read only benchmark paths explicitly named by their run packet; evaluator/oracle paths are excluded.
worker_isolation.memory_rule: Use a brand-new regular ChatGPT chat with Memory disabled before launch. Unpersonalized Temporary Chat is invalid because plugins are disabled; Personalized Temporary Chat is invalid because existing memory may be used.
worker_isolation.plugin_rule: Required plugin/app transport must remain available. For current screening arms, GitHub must be enabled; other connectors remain forbidden unless the run packet explicitly requires them.

hard_gates: objective terminal validator required for COMPLETE
frontier escalation requires lower-tier evidence and explicit residual reason
claim_limits: Static synthetic research_iterate fixtures cannot establish workspace-wide executor equivalence.
P0-P3 matrix can establish phenotype-specific comparative behavior under the frozen harness.
Broader claims require architecture_diagnosis, artifact_revision, software_debug_repair, and unseen-workflow extension suites.
Stronger frontier-equivalence claims require hidden ephemeral or externally blinded evaluator isolation.

A_frontier_long_horizon.rationale: Primary stronger-reasoning control keeps the ChatGPT chat surface and GitHub affordance matched to Instant arms; only reasoning configuration/continuity treatment should differ.

E_hybrid_escalation.escalation_rule: Only objectively evidenced INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT residuals may route to the matched-surface High control.

supplementary_ceiling_not_primary_causal.rationale: Useful as a best-available ceiling, but not the primary causal control because Work changes the execution surface and agent affordances in addition to model capability.

executor_configurations.runtime_identity_rule: Persist the exact model name and configuration reported by the surface. For GPT-5.6 on paid ChatGPT surfaces, `GPT-5.6 Sol` with `Instant` is the expected B/C/D default identity; compare configuration as well as model family. If the actual treatment differs, mark EXECUTOR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.

B6_gpt6_instant_persistent_chat.rationale: Supplementary same-surface Instant comparison against GPT-5.6 Sol / Instant. This does not replace the primary B arm; it measures model-generation effect at Instant configuration.
